In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response:
"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old nightmare. A time-hopping serial killer, known only as 'The Archon,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar streets of 1962, she must use her knowledge of future forensic techniques to leave clues that will aid her modern colleagues in catching The Archon before he strikes again.

With the help of a cryptic ally, a young FBI agent named Jack, Rachel must use her skills to outsmart The Archon and unravel the mystery of his true identity. As the body count rises, Rachel must also confront the challenges of living in a bygone era, where the rules of law enforcement are vastly different from those of her own time.

As the stakes grow higher, Rachel finds herself racing against the clock to leave a series of cryptic messages that will lead her team to The Archon's next victim. But with each passing day, The Archon seems to be one step ahead, and Rachel begins to realize that she may be the only one who can stop him.

With the help of 7 cryptic clues, 3 coded messages, and 5 crucial pieces of evidence, Rachel must use all her skills and knowledge to bring The Archon to justice. But as the clock ticks down, Rachel realizes that she may be running out of time - and that The Archon's next victim may be closer than she thinks. Can Rachel solve the mystery of The Archon's true identity before it's too late, or will she become the next victim of his deadly game?"
